The job I'd create is a weekday cron at 17:30 in America/Chicago (the company time zone, which is UTC-5 today) that posts the day's new #strategic-pod messages here. Once the scheduler is set up, I can create it, and I'd run one test post right after so you can see the format.

Someone with Gateway admin access needs to fix the scheduler's auth config first. Ping me when that's done and I'll set it up.
